address: Via del Parco Regina Margherita 45, Naples, 80121, Italy
bio: The dream of a young Neapolitan chef comes to life in an intimate, refined hideaway, tucked among the elegant streets connecting Vomero to the Chiaia waterfront. Here, dishes burst with vivid colors and Mediterranean aromas, accented by contemporary touches that reveal personality and culinary exploration. Two blind tasting menus invite discovery, or guests may opt for a well-balanced à la carte selection of land and sea, where each ingredient shines with clarity, lifted by subtle exotic nuances that awaken the senses. The wine cellar, dominated by Campanian labels, exudes tradition, yet upon request opens to selected wines by the glass, completing an experience that plays on harmony and curiosity....
